skills.name: Raging Torrent
skills.description: Deals DMG equal to 500% ATK to enemies in a dense cluster within a 3-meter radius. Deals 30% increased DMG to enemies with HP below 50%.

upgrades.level2: Crit DMG increased by 50% on critical hits.
upgrades.level4: DMG dealt to enemies with HP below 50% increased by 50%.

skills.name: Wave-Chasing Slash
skills.description: Dashes through the enemy 4 times consecutively. The first 3 hits deal 120%, 150%, and 180% ATK as DMG respectively. The final hit deals DMG equal to 250% ATK and knocks down hit enemies.

upgrades.level3: Each complete cast increases ATK by 25% for 6s.

skills.name: Wave-Surge Blade
skills.description: Passive: Each time [Wave-Chasing Slash] deals DMG, Hebo gains one stack of [Surge]. Each stack of [Surge] increases his Crit Rate by 6% for 10s.

upgrades.level2: Each stack of [Surge] increases Crit Rate by 8%.
upgrades.level4: Each stack of [Surge] increases Crit Rate by 10%.

skills.name: Mirror of Still Water
skills.description: Passive: While Hebo is casting [Wave-Chasing Slash], DMG taken is reduced by 40% and increases by 5% every 2s. After [Wave-Chasing Slash] ends, the DMG reduction effect is retained for 3s.

upgrades.level2: DMG taken during [Wave-Chasing Slash] reduced by 60%.
upgrades.level3: Upon completing [Wave-Chasing Slash], gains a Shield equal to 400% ATK.

relic.name: Return to the Vast Deep
relic.description: [Wave-Chasing Slash] restores 200 Energy each time it is fully cast.

upgrades.level2: [Wave-Chasing Slash] permanently increases Hebo's ATK by 25% each time it is fully cast, stacking up to 3 times.
upgrades.level3: [Wave-Chasing Slash] restores 300 Energy each time it is fully cast.
upgrades.level4: [Wave-Chasing Slash] permanently increases Hebo's ATK by 40% each time it is fully cast, stacking up to 3 times.
